description: Research organization lookup (ROR) — Find universities, hospitals, companies, funders and government labs in the Research Organization Registry: q= name (e.g. Stanford University) or id= ROR ID (e.g. 00f54p054), optional country= ISO-2 code filter and limit=1-20 (default 5). Returns ROR ID, display name, acronyms, aliases, other-language labels, types, status, year established, city, region, country, coordinates, website, Wikipedia, domains, external IDs (GRID, ISNI, Wikidata, Crossref Funder ID) and parent/child/successor relationships. Source: ROR (ror.org, CC0 public domain). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: research_org
